slot.brief: Series capacitor combination with dielectric slab inserted; from circuit diagram find new charge, voltage division, or energy

stem: Two identical capacitors, each of capacitance $C$ when empty, are connected in series across a battery of voltage $V$ as shown in the figure. A dielectric slab of dielectric constant $K = 3$ is inserted to completely fill capacitor $C_2$ while the battery remains connected. The ratio of the electrostatic energy stored in capacitor $C_1$ after the insertion of the slab to that before the insertion is

verdicts.working: Before: equal capacitors in series, V1 = V/2, U1 = CV²/8. After: C2 = 3C, so V1' = V·3C/(C+3C) = 3V/4, U1' = (1/2)C(3V/4)² = 9CV²/32. Ratio U1'/U1 = (9/32)/(1/8) = 9/4.

working:
Initially, both capacitors have capacitance $C_1 = C_2 = C$. In series, the initial equivalent capacitance is $C_{\text{eq}} = \dfrac{C}{2}$. The voltage across $C_1$ is $V_1 = \dfrac{V}{2}$, so the initial energy stored in $C_1$ is $U_{1, i} = \dfrac{1}{2} C V_1^2 = \dfrac{1}{8} C V^2$. After the dielectric slab of constant $K = 3$ is inserted into $C_2$, the new capacitances are $C_1' = C$ and $C_2' = 3C$. The new equivalent capacitance is $C_{\text{eq}}' = \dfrac{C \times 3C}{C + 3C} = \dfrac{3}{4} C$. The total charge supplied by the battery (and therefore on $C_1$) becomes $Q' = C_{\text{eq}}' V = \dfrac{3}{4} C V$. The new energy stored in $C_1$ is $U_{1, f} = \dfrac{(Q')^2}{2 C_1'} = \dfrac{(3CV/4)^2}{2C} = \dfrac{9}{32} C V^2$. Therefore, the ratio of the final to initial energy in $C_1$ is $\dfrac{U_{1, f}}{U_{1, i}} = \dfrac{9/32}{1/8} = \dfrac{9}{4} = 9 : 4$.

Independent check: Before: equal capacitors in series, V1 = V/2, U1 = CV²/8. After: C2 = 3C, so V1' = V·3C/(C+3C) = 3V/4, U1' = (1/2)C(3V/4)² = 9CV²/32. Ratio U1'/U1 = (9/32)/(1/8) = 9/4.

Option B (3 : 4) comes from finding the ratio of final to initial energy in capacitor C_2 instead of C_1. figure.description: A single-loop rectangular circuit diagram. The bottom horizontal branch contains a DC battery labeled 'V', with the longer positive plate on the left and the shorter negative plate on the right. The top horizontal branch contains two capacitors in series: on the left is an air-gap capacitor labeled 'C_1', and on the right is an identical capacitor labeled 'C_2' whose inter-plate space is completely filled by a shaded dielectric slab labeled 'K = 3'. Straight connecting wires complete the rectangular loop.
